results.title: Ungli
results.overview: When a corrupt judicial system lets a drunken driver off scott-free, four gym friends become vigilantes to avenge the death of their trainer.

results.title: Dil Hai Ke Manta Nahin
results.overview: Runaway heiress in search of her beloved falls in love with another man on the way.

results.title: Plan A Plan B
results.overview: When an earnest matchmaker moves into an office next to a cynical divorce attorney, their bitter conflict is complicated by a growing attraction.

results.title: Omkara
results.overview: Half-caste bandit Omkara Shukla abducts his lady love, Dolly Mishra, from her family. Thanks to his cleverness, he gets away with the kidnapping. A conspiracy, however, forms against him when he denies his right-hand man, Langda Tyagi, a promotion. Ultimately, this plot threatens not only his relationship with Dolly, but their lives and those of their associates as well.

results.title: Tanu Weds Manu: Returns
results.overview: After Tanu and Manu's marriage breaks apart, the latter finds himself smitten by Datto, a lookalike of his ex-wife. But the estranged couple's feelings begin to spark again.

results.title: Ram Jaane
results.overview: A street hustler, who has spent several years in and out of prison, decides to reform his life, as he teaches street kids to stay away from crime, but has trouble maintaining these ideals in his own life.

results.title: Selfiee
results.overview: RTO officer Om Prakash strikes a golden opportunity to meet his icon, Vijay Kumar. Bhut when his love gets spurned by the superstar, a clash of egos ensues.

results.title: Raksha Bandhan
results.overview: Lala Kedarnath is blessed with 4 sisters. But his only worry is to find suitable grooms for each of them, as only then can he marry his childhood love. To what lengths will he go to succeed?

results.title: Kedarnath
results.overview: Mansoor, a reserved and reticent Pithoo (porter), helps pilgrims make an arduous journey upwards to the temple town. His world turns around when he meets the beautiful and rebellious Mukku who draws him into a whirlwind of intense love.

results.title: Mausam
results.overview: A war, religious conflicts, and misunderstandings create obstacles for a couple of different faiths.

results.title: Dev.D
results.overview: Dev, after spurning his childhood love Paro due to a misunderstanding, turns to drugs and alcohol for solace. Paro moves on but Dev remains in remorse. He then meets Chanda, an escort navigating her own past trauma, but Dev’s chauvinistic attitude and penchant for self-destruction stands in the way of their developing bond.

results.title: Highway
results.overview: Right before her wedding, a young woman finds herself abducted and held for ransom. As the initial days pass, she begins to develop a strange bond with her kidnapper.

results.title: Guilty
results.overview: A young woman from a small town accuses the college heartthrob of sexual assault.

results.title: English Babu Desi Mem
results.overview: Vikram Mayur is looking after his late brother's eight-year-old son and is torn between choosing to take Nandu back to England to learn his family's business, or risk throwing it all way.

results.title: NH10
results.overview: Meera and Arjun are professionals living in Gurgaon. On their way to a luxurious desert holiday they stop on a Highway dhaba for dinner, where they witness a young girl being picked up by a bunch of hoodlums. Arjun chooses to step in, unmindful of the danger ahead.

results.title: Mere Brother Ki Dulhan
results.overview: A Mumbai man finds himself in an unpredictable situation when the prospective bride of his older brother is a woman he has history with.

results.title: Bhuj: The Pride of India
results.overview: Set in the backdrop of the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War, the film tells the story of the IAF Squadron Leader Vijay Karnik, and his bravery, patriotism and determination.

results.title: Mela
results.overview: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

results.title: One 2 Ka 4
results.overview: After his partner, Javed, is killed, Arun takes care of the four orphaned children with the help of Geeta. He discovers Javed's death was a homicide, and as he investigates, he learns that Geeta is leading a double life.

results.title: Masti
results.overview: Three henpecked friends try to escape their unhappy marriages by seeking out some extramarital fun, only to end up being blackmailed.
